headline: Hovstead United increase pressure
body: Between the 17th and 27th minute at Levmoor Park, Hovstead United won the ball back 12 times in the opposition half.

headline: Gosibof Vokafet puts Hovstead United ahead
body: Gosibof Vokafet scored with his right foot from three metres, giving Hovstead United a 1-0 lead over Levmoor Wanderers at Levmoor Park. The goal, set up by Beheti Bidoguk after a three‑pass, fifteen‑second buildup and a thirty‑six‑metre run, saw four Hovstead United attackers inside the box.

headline: Hatidus Fadifig says no
body: Hatidus Fadifig (Levmoor Wanderers) keeps out Beheti Bidoguk's effort from 12 metres in minute 33.

headline: Bidoguk scores as Hovstead United extend lead
body: Beheti Bidoguk netted with his left foot from 17 metres after a 27‑second, eight‑pass build‑up that saw the ball progress 41 metres, assisted by Ragusi Zatig, with four Hovstead United attackers inside the box. The goal came after a high‑press win and long build‑up at Levmoor Park, putting Hovstead United 2‑0 up over Levmoor Wanderers.

headline: GOAL! Bagisu Kosezov scores for Levmoor Wanderers
body: Bagisu Kosezov heads in from a high press win at Levmoor Park, making it Levmoor Wanderers 1-2 Hovstead United, with three Levmoor players in the box.

headline: Levmoor Wanderers fight back
body: Levmoor Wanderers fell behind in minute 23, but Honeka Zevatas equalised as the match finished 2-2.

headline: Horeri Hobit puts Levmoor Wanderers ahead
body: Horeri Hobit scored with his left foot from six metres after a high‑press win, his teammate Bagisu Kosezov providing the assist following a one‑pass, three‑second build‑up covering three metres, giving Levmoor Wanderers a 3‑2 lead over Hovstead United at Levmoor Park.

headline: Horeri Hobit scores decisive goal for Levmoor Wanderers
body: Substituted on in the 71st minute, Horeri Hobit netted in the 77th to secure a 3-2 win for Levmoor Wanderers over Hovstead United at Levmoor Park.

headline: Hotabu Rerager says no
body: Hotabu Rerager (Hovstead United) keeps out Bagisu Kosezov's effort from 11 metres in minute 84.

headline: Horeri Hobit nets late winner for Levmoor Wanderers
body: Horeri Hobit scored with his right foot from seven metres, assisted by Kubahi Memem, as Levmoor Wanderers secured a 4‑2 victory over Hovstead United at Levmoor Park, with five attackers inside the box.

headline: Hobit’s substitute strike secures Levmoor’s 4-2 victory
body: Horeri Hobit entered for Levmoor Wanderers in the 71st minute and netted the decisive goal in the 84th, sealing a 4-2 win over Hovstead United at Levmoor Park.

headline: Goal! Rurohov Higodut scores for Hovstead United
body: Rurohov Higodut netted with his right foot from 24 m after a one‑pass, four‑second buildup by Gosibof Vokafet, giving Levmoor Wanderers a 4‑3 win at Levmoor Park.

headline: Rurohov Higodut's impact after 54th‑minute substitution
body: Rurohov Higodut was introduced for Hovstead United at Levmoor Park in the 54th minute, as Levmoor Wanderers secured a 4‑3 victory.

headline: Bagisu Kosezov dominates for Levmoor Wanderers
body: Bagisu Kosezov of Levmoor Wanderers recorded 10 shots, making up 62% of his team's attempts from 62 touches, and scored one goal. He also provided two key passes.

headline: FULL TIME: Levmoor Wanderers 4-3 Hovstead United
body: Levmoor Wanderers beat Hovstead United at Levmoor Park, finishing 4‑3. They recorded 16 shots with an 86% pass rate, while Hovstead United had 8 shots and an 81% pass rate.
